resources.string: Show phone notifications on your computers
See, reply to and clear them from your paired Mac or PC. They go only to your own devices, encrypted.
Turn on “%1$s” in the system settings. If its switch is greyed out, open App info › ⋮ › Allow restricted settings first, then try again.

AirBridge will read the notifications on this phone and show them on the computers you paired, so you can reply or clear them there.

They are sent only to your own paired devices, encrypted, and never uploaded anywhere. Nothing is sent while this switch is off.

On the next screen, turn on “%1$s”. If the switch is greyed out, go back, open App info › ⋮ › Allow restricted settings, and try again.
Notifications from apps that are on reach your computers. Apps that posted recently come first.
When the lock screen hides sensitive content, notifications wait until you unlock the phone.
See who is calling, then answer, decline or end the call from your computer. The call audio stays on your phone.

To show calls and answer or end them, AirBridge needs the Phone permission. Contacts are optional and only used to show names for numbers.

The call itself stays on your phone: talk through its speaker, earpiece or a Bluetooth headset. Android doesn't let apps carry call audio to a computer.

Call details are sent only to your own paired devices, encrypted.
Only calls your phone app shows in a notification reach your computer, and answering may not work. Allow Phone in the app permissions.
